performance.verdict: Meta driving all leads; Google spend unaccountable and pipeline intake broken.

findings.text: Meta produced all 19 28-day leads at $41.79 CPL ($794.06 spend); Google spent $2,257.98 and delivered 7 conversions with 0 GA4 conversion events — attribution is broken, not the channel.

5 overdue milestones (Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting) all past due by 2026-07-31–08-01 — engagement is 2.5 months in with no confirmed launch.
GHL shows 81 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 0 pipeline value — 19 paid leads are entering but none advancing; intake process is the leak, not ad volume.
3-day Meta lead signal (Sep 12–14: 2+1+1=4 leads) is weaker than prior 3 days (Sep 9–11: 1+4+3=8 leads) on flat ~$50–53/day spend — early fatigue signal after the 250% spike.
GBP actions fell 55.1% week-over-week; last 2 days in series show 0 GBP actions — organic local visibility is declining while paid spend holds, suggesting GBP profile maintenance gap.

suggestions.text: Repair Google Ads conversion tracking via GTM/pixel audit — $2,257.98 spend is unaccountable until GA4 shows non-zero conversions.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads consumed $2,257.98 over 28 days but GA4 shows 0 conversion events — we cannot confirm or deny ROI until pixel/GTM fires correctly. Audit the Google tag and conversion actions in GTM; confirm events fire on the thank-you or form-submit page end-to-end. Success = at least one verified conversion event visible in GA4 and Google Ads within 48 hours of fix. Complete by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake: 81 opportunities, 0 appointments, 0 won — leads are arriving but no case progression; fix routing or speed-to-lead before scaling spend.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 81 opportunities created against 0 appointments and 0 pipeline value — paid leads are entering the CRM but stalling immediately after intake. Confirm that routing rules, auto-reply, and calendar booking links are live and functional per the SOW speed-to-lead spec (under 5 min in business hours). Success = at least 3 appointments booked within 7 days of fix. Verify by 2026-09-22.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days — lead rate halved (8 leads Sep 9–11 vs 4 leads Sep 12–14) on flat spend; pause creative refresh decision until confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 8 leads Sep 9–11 but only 4 leads Sep 12–14 on similar daily spend (~$50/day) — a probable fatigue signal but not yet confirmed across 3 full days. No creative change this cycle. Re-check the 3-day lead rate on 2026-09-18; if leads per day stay below 1.5 on equal or rising spend, escalate to creative_refresh.
